title: Phase A baseline for the operator's exact trade: XAUUSD, 0.50 lot, +$15 take-profit against a -$15 stop, entered at every eligible bar, BUY and SELL measured separately, with bid / ask execution and costs
status: APPROVED by the operator 2026-11-08; written and committed before any of its code; descriptive research on an isolated branch, no production change
approval: Operator, 2026-11-08 (chat, NEXT EXECUTION ORDER - PHASE 2): "You are authorized to: 1. Register a new research study for symmetric XAUUSD TP +$15 / SL -$15. 2. Use the existing website Python engine as the research environment ... PHASE A - Establish baseline ... Test BUY and SELL independently ... Test the exact symmetric +-$15 model independently. Do not reuse the results of the earlier +$15/-$13 experiments as proof."
unsealed_data_also_used: 2026 'recent' (2026-03-01 on, after the sealed holdout) and the live store's 5m bars (September 2026 to 2026-11-06). No validation (2023-01-24 .. 2024-07-01) or holdout (2024-07-01 .. 2026-01-01) bar is read; they stay sealed for Phase F.
what_this_is: A baseline, not a strategy. Every eligible bar is an entry, in both directions, with no filter. It measures what the market gives a +-$15 bracket before any rule is applied: the number every later model must beat, BUY and SELL separately, by session, weekday, volatility, trend and news. No parameter is chosen from it and no pass / fail is declared.

data.P1_development: Twelve Data XAU/USD 15m (research-data branch, read through quantum.research.history.load: market-shut prints removed), 2020-04-01 .. 2023-01-24 (the harness development partition, scored from b13.SCORE_FROM). Distances and costs scaled by k = price / 4000 at the decision bar, results reported in 4000-equivalent dollars, as every earlier study.
data.P2_recent: Twelve Data XAU/USD 15m, 2026-03-01 .. end of the research history (2026-11-02). Literal dollars (k = 1).
data.P3_store_5m: The live store's Twelve Data XAU/USD 5m bars (market-data branch), cleaned as the site does (quantum.data.sources.trading_week_only, repair_reopen), September 2026 .. 2026-11-06. Literal dollars. This is the execution timeframe; it is two months long.
data.context: Higher-timeframe context from Twelve Data 1h bars (research history, extended by the live store's 60m after 2026-11-02): 4h and 1D built on the New York 17:00 session (sources.resample_ny_session, daily_ny_session).
data.repair: repair_reopen is applied to the execution bars of every population (the stale first print after a closure becomes the bar's close), so a carried quote cannot fake a gap fill.
data.volume: Not used. Twelve Data XAU/USD has no volume; tick volume is not traded volume.

entries.decision: At the close of every bar i in the scored window, both BUY and SELL.
entries.fill: At the open of bar i+1, the first price after the decision. BUY at the ask, SELL at the bid, plus the scenario's entry slippage against the trade.
eligible_only_if: bar i+1 starts exactly one bar after bar i (no daily break or weekend between the decision and the fill)
no market closure (a gap of more than 2 hours between bars) starts within 60 minutes after the decision
the decision bar is at or after the population's scoring start

exits.levels: From the actual fill: BUY TP = fill + 15k, SL = fill - 15k; SELL TP = fill - 15k, SL = fill + 15k.
exits.triggers: A BUY's TP and SL trigger on the bid (mid - s/2), a SELL's on the ask (mid + s/2). Bars are mid prices; s is the scenario spread at the entry, held for the trade.
exits.path: From bar i+1 (its open, high and low) forward, on the population's own bars (5m for P3, 15m for P1 / P2).
exits.gap: If a bar opens beyond the stop, the stop fills at that open (bid / ask) less the exit slippage. If it opens beyond the target, the target fills at the target (a limit order; the better open price is not credited).
exits.same_bar: A bar that reaches both levels counts as the stop (AMBIGUOUS, reported separately).
exits.time_limit: 2 trading days (576 5m bars / 192 15m bars): exit at that bar's close (TIMEOUT).
exits.closure: A trade still open at the last bar before a closure longer than 2 hours (the weekend, a holiday) exits at that bar's close (CLOSURE). The daily one-hour break is held through, with the gap rule at the reopen.
exits.exit_slippage: Applied to stop, TIMEOUT and CLOSURE exits (market or stop orders), not to target fills (limit orders).

cost_scenarios.GROSS: spread 0, slippage 0, commission 0: the bracket on mid prices
cost_scenarios.OP: the operator's $0.26 per oz, taken as all-in spread (no slippage, no commission); unverified against the broker
cost_scenarios.ENG (primary): the frozen engine model's components (quantum.research.harness.cost_pts): spread 0.30 in London / New York / kill zones and 0.50 off session, 0.20 slippage on the entry and on non-target exits, commission 7 USD per lot round trip (0.07 per oz)
cost_scenarios.ADV: adverse: twice the ENG spread, 0.40 slippage per side, the same commission
cost_scenarios.money: Per 0.50 lot assuming a 100 oz contract (50 oz): USD per oz x 50. Labelled ASSUMED until the broker's XAUUSD specification is received; no monetary figure is approved before then.

per_trade_record: decision time and price, fill time and price, direction, TP, SL
first level reached (TP / SL / AMBIGUOUS / TIMEOUT / CLOSURE), gap flag, exit time and price, minutes to the outcome
MFE and MAE from the fill to the exit (dollars, on the trigger side's prices)
spread, entry slippage, exit slippage, commission, gross and net P/L per oz and per 0.50 lot (ENG); outcome and net P/L under GROSS, OP and ADV
session (ASIA / LONDON / OVERLAP / NY / OFF from quantum.sessions.calendar), New York trading weekday, volatility tercile, trend state, news window, price direction at +1h and +4h

regimes.volatility: ATR(14) of the last completed 1h bar divided by its close, ranked against the trailing 90 calendar days of the same series: LOW (bottom third), MID, HIGH (top third). Trailing window only.
regimes.trend: Three votes from completed bars only: 1D close vs EMA50 of 1D closes; 4h EMA20 vs EMA50; 1h EMA20 vs EMA50. UP = all three up, DOWN = all three down, MIXED otherwise. Reported as WITH (BUY in UP, SELL in DOWN), AGAINST and MIXED.
regimes.news: Entry from 30 minutes before to 120 minutes after a dated CPI / NFP / FOMC release (quantum.research.b8_news.DATES for 2020 .. 2023-01; quantum.news_calendar from 2026-10-28). Between 2023-02 and 2026-10-27 no dated list is held: those trades are NOT DATED, not 'no news'.

statistics.all_bar_population: Every eligible entry. Rates with a 95% interval from a day-clustered bootstrap (2,000 resamples of New York trading days, harness.seeded_rng(26)): entries hours apart overlap and are not independent.
statistics.sequential_series: Per direction, non-overlapping: the next decision is the bar on which the previous trade exited. This is the independent-trade count; Wilson 95% intervals; expectancy, profit factor, maximum drawdown and the longest losing run on it.
statistics.references: For each scenario: the rate a driftless market gives this bracket after the spread and entry slippage, mean over trades of (15k - s - slip_in) / 30k; and the break-even rate from the average net win and loss.
statistics.prediction_scorecard: Directional accuracy (price beyond the fill in the trade's direction at +1h and +4h) and the Brier score of the constant base-rate forecast, which any model must beat.
statistics.execution_scorecard: TP-first, SL-first, AMBIGUOUS, gap fills, TIMEOUT / CLOSURE, minutes to the outcome, MAE / MFE, entry slippage vs the decision close.
statistics.profitability_scorecard: Gross, costs, net, expectancy per oz and per 0.50 lot (ASSUMED 100 oz), profit factor, maximum drawdown, longest losing run.
statistics.resolution_check: On the P3 window: decisions at 15m closes resolved on 15m bars and on 5m bars, to measure what 15m resolution does to P1 / P2.
statistics.sanity_check_not_a_test: The GROSS TP-first rate with no drift should be near 50%; a departure is drift or a labeller error and is investigated, not used.

decision: None. This registration declares no hypothesis and selects nothing. Its outputs are the reference rates for Phases C-F; any regime that looks different here becomes its own registered hypothesis before it is tested on validation.
unchanged: Production engine, config, web.8 and its freeze key, the frozen Pine reference, the developed Pine line, phone alerts, PR #90 and PR #91. Research code is never imported by production (tests/test_integrity.py).
